localHeading: Doors and weather seals along the westshore
localIntro: Bay Village is part of the Lake Erie westshore corridor. A door that lets in wind or water deserves a closer look at the bottom seal, side seals, and panel fit before the next rough weather arrives.
localIssues: We can inspect whether the door closes evenly against the floor and whether the opener safety system still reverses correctly.
localAdvice: For an older door, we can explain when replacing a worn seal is enough and when damaged panels make a new door more sensible.
